name: DuckDB Foreign Key Audit and Hardening
description: Finish the DuckDB foreign-key audit, add missing regression coverage, and harden the highest-confidence constraint and logical-reference failure paths across prompts, projects, providers, and maintenance cleanup flows.

userStories.title: Complete the remaining FK audit inventory
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the FOR_KEY audit to cover the remaining unreviewed routes, jobs, and maintenance writers so the hardening plan does not miss hidden parent-child mutations.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit the remaining unreviewed FK-sensitive surfaces, including `src/server/routes/HumanAssessmentRoutes/**`, remaining admin or cron writers, and maintenance-only rebuild paths that are not yet captured in `FOR_KEY.md`.
Update `FOR_KEY.md` with any new risks, coverage gaps, priorities, or accepted-risk notes discovered during the remaining audit pass.

userStories.title: Relink comparison-project prompts during prompt merge
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want prompt merge to rewrite `comparison_project_prompt` rows before deleting the merged prompt so comparison projects survive merges without DuckDB FK failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt merge rewrites `app.comparison_project_prompt` rows from the merged prompt id to the kept prompt id before deleting the merged prompt row.
Add a regression test that merges a prompt still referenced by a comparison project and completes without a foreign-key error.
The merged prompt row is deleted only after all comparison-project prompt references point at the kept prompt.
